name: Western Connecticut Highlands

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A Connecticut AVA covering all of Litchfield County and parts of Fairfield, New Haven and Hartford. It has little water moderation, a cool climate and a short growing season of mid-May to mid-September. The soil is glacial schist and gneiss.
